name: tallybot
title: tallybot
blurb: a leaderboard of arbitrarily named points, not accounts: sign in with Bluesky and give any name you type a +1 or -1, or just post "<name> +1" anywhere on Bluesky and it counts the same, no sign-in needed. scores persist globally, server-enforced off a live Jetstream feed. built from a @cee.wtf riff on socialcredit's vote syntax.
